title: Move Gemini API key from URL query string to X-Goog-Api-Key header
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-LLM-005

`GeminiProvider.cs` (line ~30) embeds the API key in the URL query string: `$"/v1beta/models/{options.LlmModel}:generateContent?key={options.LlmApiKey}"`. Keys in URLs appear in server access logs, proxy/cache logs, browser referrer headers, crash dumps, and `HttpRequestException` message text.

**Recommendation:** Change to `req.Headers.Add("X-Goog-Api-Key", options.LlmApiKey)` and POST to the endpoint without the `?key=` parameter.
